### Contributor's provenance rule (verbatim conditions, paraphrased structure)

From the clarification message:

- If the fixture is used **unchanged**, keep its **fixture ID and SHA-256**.
- If the fixture is **adapted**, give the derivative a **new ID**, record the
  **original fixture ID and digest as its provenance**, and credit **EMILIA
  Protocol**. That keeps the contributed case distinct from a variant written
  for `-01`.
- The **original fixture stays pinned to AEB `-04`**; a derived case or the
  `-01` related-work text can point to the current AEB revision.

The author's public response
(<https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/scitt/Ei71eBl2k0_hW32hqvqvyGzEuAM/>)
confirms the digest was verified on receipt and commits to preserving the
fixture ID and crediting EMILIA Protocol if the case or its structure is
incorporated.
